name: Killian, Decisive Mentor
oracle_text:
Whenever an enchantment you control enters, tap up to one target creature and goad it. (Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)
Whenever one or more creatures that are enchanted by an Aura you control attack, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more creatures that are enchanted by an Aura you control attack, draw a card.

needs.what: a trigger-filter key matching a creature that has at least one Aura attached to it whose controller is the trigger source's controller (e.g. `enchanted_by: {"controller": "you"}`), usable on a batched `attacks` trigger with no controller restriction, so the ability fires once when any creatures -- an opponent's goaded creatures included -- enchanted by your Auras attack
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `attached`, which in triggers.py matches only the one object the ability source itself is attached to (Skullclamp's 'equipped creature'); nothing reads the Auras attached to an arbitrary attacker or their controller. `controller: you` on the attacks trigger would be both wrong (misses opponents' creatures carrying your Auras) and too wide (fires for your unenchanted creatures)
